## Safety review

- [ ] No unexpected provider calls, spending, Git writes or customer data access
- [ ] No sandbox, fencing, cancellation or verification invariants weakened
- [ ] No secrets, private source snippets, raw prompts or sensitive logs committed
- [ ] No undocumented persistence/schema migration
- [ ] Independent oracle or reviewer evidence for safety-sensitive changes
